newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union - Auckland want to play semi on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union - Auckland want to play semi on Saturday.

text.p: WELLINGTON, May 13 - If the Wellington Hurricanes' finish second or third in the Super 12 competition, their semifinal will be played on May 25, NZPA reports.
With the Auckland Blues guaranteed top qualification spot they get the call on which day to play their semifinal match.
Wellington, three points ahead of fourth-placed Natal, will play the Sunday semifinal if Natal are beaten by Gauteng this weekend.
However if Natal collect maximum points, the Hurricanes must get at least two bonus points against ACT on Sunday to avoid finishing fourth and facing Auckland in the Saturday semifinal.
On Tuesday an Auckland spokeswoman Jodi Gill confirmed the Blues wanted to play their semifinal on the Saturday, leaving the other semifinal as the Sunday game.
If Auckland make the final, that game will be played on Saturday, May 31, Gill said.
